screener_note: ARK Innovation watchlist screener in TradingView. Fallback: if screener tab is not open, morning.js falls through to the static watchlist array below. Reorder watchlist to prioritize symbols for the fallback path.
strategy_note: ARK names are narrative and catalyst-driven — they gap 15-30% on news, base for weeks, then move again. Trend-following oscillators whipsaw. This strategy identifies stocks outperforming QQQ that are building a tight base after a prior move, then enters on a volume breakout from that base. TWB is used only as a breakout confirmation signal, not as a trend direction filter. NW Envelope upper band is the price target, not a trend gate.

market_context.benchmark_filter: QQQ must be above its 50-day EMA for any long entries. If QQQ is below 50d EMA, all signals are neutral — wait for market to recover.
market_context.note: ARK holdings are high-beta growth: genomics, fintech, AI, space, autonomous vehicles. Many are pre-profit. Catalyst and narrative matter more than technicals alone. A stock can have a perfect setup and still fail without a catalyst. Always check for upcoming earnings, FDA dates, product launches before entry.

base_building: Stock outperforming QQQ over last 20 days (RS positive — stock up more or down less than QQQ)
Price consolidating in a tight range for 2-6 weeks after a prior impulsive move up
Volume contracting during the base — daily volume declining toward average or below
NW Envelope: price inside bands with no recent ▲ or ▼ signal — coiling, not extended
breakout_ready: Price approaching the top of the base / prior resistance level
TWB Histogram turning positive or crossing above signal line after being near zero
No earnings within 5 trading days — avoid entering into binary events
skip: Stock underperforming QQQ over last 20 days
Price extended — NW ▲ signal already printed (upper band already hit, move played out)
Volume rising during consolidation — distribution pattern, not accumulation
Earnings within 5 trading days — wait until after the report
neutral: No clear base forming — stock in a choppy range with no tightening
TWB Histogram near zero with no direction — no conviction
RS vs QQQ flat — neither outperforming nor underperforming

long: Price breaks above the top of the base / resistance level on a single candle
Breakout candle volume significantly above the contracting base volume (ideally 2x+ the base average)
TWB prints a breakout signal (B above trendline) on or within 1-2 bars of the breakout
Price NOT already outside NW upper band — if upper band already hit, skip (extended)
Identifiable catalyst present or imminent (sector rotation, product news, macro risk-on)

exit_criteria.stop_loss: Below the low of the base (undercut = failed breakout, exit immediately). If base is wide, use the breakout candle low as stop instead.
exit_criteria.failed_breakout: If price closes back below the breakout level on the same day or next — exit immediately. Do not hold through a failed breakout.
exit_criteria.take_profit_1: Scale out 1/3 to 1/2 when price reaches the NW Envelope upper band.
exit_criteria.take_profit_2: Trail remainder using the prior day's low as a trailing stop. Exit if price closes below previous day's low after TP1 hit.
exit_criteria.time_stop: If price does not extend beyond the breakout level within 5 trading days, exit — the move has stalled.

risk_rules: Max 3 open ARK positions at once — these names are highly correlated (TSLA, COIN, PLTR, NVDA move together in risk-on/off)
No entries if QQQ below 50-day EMA
Reduce position size 25% vs standard stocks — ARK names are 2-3x beta
Volume confirmation on breakout is mandatory — a low-volume breakout in these names fails most of the time
No entry in first 15 minutes of NYSE open (9:30-9:45 ET)
Never hold through earnings — pre-profit ARK names gap violently on reports
Min R:R 1:2 before entry (base width = risk; NW upper band = reward target)
rs_guidance: Relative strength vs QQQ is the primary filter but cannot be read directly from TV indicators in this scan. Approximate it from the quote data: if SPY/QQQ is -2% over 20 days and the stock is -0.5%, it has positive RS. If SPY is +3% and the stock is flat, RS is negative — skip it.

asset_notes.note: Reorder the watchlist to put your highest-conviction names first — only max_symbols are scanned per run.
asset_notes.high_beta_warning: ARK holdings average 2-3x beta vs SPY. A 1% QQQ move = 2-3% move in these names. Size accordingly.
asset_notes.cluster_rule: Do not hold more than one name from the same correlation cluster simultaneously.
